observations.behavior: Replaces row-wise histogram quantile computation with a merge-first approach, adding histogram_bounds and series_fingerprints to the response.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog to return the bucket edges used for the quantile estimate, and merge multiple series sharing the same time bucket before computing the quantile, rather than failing when bucket layouts differ.

observations.behavior: Adds histogram_bounds to the histogram_bounds field in the metricsViewerLogic component.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the frontend to receive and display the bucket upper edges for histogram quantile series, which are estimated from the stored lower edges. This could help users interpret the results of histogram_quantile queries, especially for exponential histograms where the backend converts lower edges to upper edges for quantile calculation.
